==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Two distinct things I remember with very little context are fire fighters with harpoon guns and humanoid gryphon women cyborgs with pink metal armor. Both things are very random.

I specifically remember the fire fighters shooting their harpoons into the air. It seemed like they were trying to shoot something out of the sky. Maybe they were fighting the gryphon women?

Maybe the gryphon women were actually more like phoenix women? That would make a little more sense. If I were a fire fighter, I probably wouldn't like having to deal with flaming bird people perching on rooftops all the time.
